faqPage.heroSubtitle: Quickly find answers to your questions about Convessa, our WhatsApp API, and our services.
faqPage.ctaSubtitle: Our support team is here to help

questions.question: What is Convessa?
questions.answer: Convessa is a SaaS platform that lets developers easily integrate the WhatsApp API into their applications. We provide a simple REST API to send and receive WhatsApp messages without the complexity of a direct implementation.

questions.question: Is Convessa an official WhatsApp product?
questions.answer: No, Convessa uses the WhatsApp Web API (Baileys protocol) to connect to your account. It's the same technology used by WhatsApp Web in your browser. We are not affiliated with WhatsApp/Meta.

questions.question: Can I use Convessa with WhatsApp Business?
questions.answer: Yes! Convessa works with both personal and WhatsApp Business accounts. You can use any type of WhatsApp account. We recommend WhatsApp Business for professional use.

questions.question: In which countries is Convessa available?
questions.answer: Convessa is available in every country where WhatsApp works. Our platform supports international numbers with the country code (e.g. +229 for Benin, +33 for France, etc.)

questions.question: Is my data secure?
questions.answer: Absolutely. We use WhatsApp's end-to-end encryption and don't store any messages. Your data stays between you and WhatsApp. We only store the metadata needed for the service to run (message status, queue).

questions.question: Where is my data stored?
questions.answer: WhatsApp sessions are encrypted and stored securely on our servers. Messages are never stored — they pass directly between your application and WhatsApp. We comply with GDPR.

questions.question: Who can see my messages?
questions.answer: No one! Thanks to WhatsApp's end-to-end encryption, only you and your recipients can read the messages. Even Convessa and WhatsApp cannot read the content of your messages.

questions.question: How do I protect my API key?
questions.answer: NEVER share your API key publicly. Store it in environment variables (.env), use secret managers (like AWS Secrets Manager), and never include it in your source code or Git repositories.

questions.question: Which programming languages are supported?
questions.answer: Convessa is a standard REST API, so it works with any language capable of making HTTP requests: JavaScript/Node.js, Python, PHP, Java, C#, Go, Ruby, etc. We provide code examples for the most popular languages.

questions.question: What is the message rate limit?
questions.answer: To prevent spam, we limit sending to 20 messages per minute on the free plan and 100 messages/minute on paid plans. If you need higher limits, contact us for a custom Enterprise plan.

questions.question: How do I receive incoming messages?
questions.answer: Set up a webhook in your dashboard. Convessa will send a POST request to your URL for every message received. You'll get the message data as JSON (sender, content, timestamp, etc.)

questions.question: Can I send media (images, videos)?
questions.answer: Yes! Convessa supports sending images (16MB max), videos (64MB max), audio (16MB max) and documents (100MB max). Media is sent as base64 through the API.

questions.question: Is there a character limit for messages?
questions.answer: Yes, WhatsApp messages are limited to 4096 characters. Beyond that, the message will be truncated. If you need to send more text, split it into several messages.

questions.question: How much does Convessa cost?
questions.answer: We offer a free plan (100 messages/month), a Pro plan at €29/month (5000 messages), and custom Enterprise plans with unlimited messages. Check our Pricing page for more details.

questions.question: Are there any hidden fees?
questions.answer: No! The price shown is the price you pay. No setup fees, no extra per-message charges beyond your included quota. If you exceed your quota, your service is simply paused until the next month.

questions.question: Can I change plans at any time?
questions.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time from your dashboard. Changes take effect immediately. In case of a downgrade, you keep your quota until the end of the current billing period.

questions.question: Do you offer discounts for nonprofits?
questions.answer: Yes! We offer discounts of up to 50% for nonprofit organizations, schools, and open-source projects. Contact us with details about your organization.

questions.question: My QR code isn't working
questions.answer: Make sure that: 1) Your phone has a stable internet connection, 2) WhatsApp is up to date on your phone, 3) The QR code hasn't expired (60 seconds), 4) You're using the right feature in WhatsApp (Menu > Linked devices > Link a device).

questions.question: My messages aren't being sent
questions.answer: Check: 1) That your WhatsApp session is connected (Dashboard > My Session), 2) That you haven't exceeded your monthly quota, 3) That the recipient's number is in international format (+XXX...), 4) That your API key is correct in your HTTP headers.

questions.question: My WhatsApp account got banned
questions.answer: Using unofficial APIs carries a risk of being banned by WhatsApp. To minimize this risk: 1) Use a dedicated WhatsApp Business account, 2) Do NOT send spam, 3) Respect rate limits, 4) Add a delay between messages. We recommend the official WhatsApp Business API for critical use cases.

questions.question: I lost my API key
questions.answer: Log in to your dashboard. Your API key is shown in the 'My WhatsApp Session' section. You can copy it at any time. If you think your key has been compromised, contact support to have it regenerated.

questions.question: How do I contact support?
questions.answer: Community support (free plan): Discord and GitHub Discussions. Email support (Pro plan): Response within 24 business hours. Priority 24/7 support (Enterprise plan): Email, phone, and dedicated Slack.

questions.question: Is there documentation for developers?
questions.answer: Yes! Our full documentation is available at /docs. It includes getting-started guides, the complete API reference, code examples in several languages, and step-by-step tutorials.

questions.question: Do you offer integrations with other services?
questions.answer: Yes, Convessa integrates easily with Zapier, Make (formerly Integromat), n8n, and other automation platforms. We also provide webhooks to integrate with your own systems.

questions.question: Where can I see usage examples?
questions.answer: Check our Examples section at /examples (coming soon) or our GitHub repository with example projects in Node.js, Python, PHP, and other languages.

quickAnswers.apiKey: Your API key (`pk_convessa_...`) is automatically generated once you connect your WhatsApp number. Find it in the [Sessions](/sessions) tab.
quickAnswers.connectWhatsapp:
To connect WhatsApp:
1. Go to the [Sessions](/sessions) tab
2. Click **Connect WhatsApp**
3. Scan the QR code from your phone (WhatsApp > Linked Devices).
quickAnswers.pricing: Convessa offers a free plan for testing, a Pro plan at 29€/month, and an Enterprise option. View full details on the [Pricing](/pricing) page.
quickAnswers.docs: All our REST API integration documentation and code examples per language are available on the [Documentation](/docs) page.
quickAnswers.groups: You can create and manage your WhatsApp groups from the [Send Message](/send-message) section or via the `/api/v1/groups` endpoints.
quickAnswers.webhooks: Configure your Webhook in the [Dashboard](/dashboard) to receive incoming messages and delivery receipts in real time on your server.
quickAnswers.mediaLimits:
Media file size limits:
- Images: 16 MB max (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP)
- Videos: 64 MB max (MP4, 3GPP)
- Audio: 16 MB max (MP3, OGG, AAC)
- Documents: 100 MB max (PDF, DOC, TXT)
quickAnswers.support: You can reach our technical support team on the [Contact](/contact) page or join our community.
